content.text: The text reviews diseases of the liver and biliary system. It describes urine tests for albumen and bile, the physiology and symptoms of jaundice, and treatment through diet, laxatives, mineral waters, and historical medications. It then discusses hepatic congestion, perihepatitis, cirrhosis, abscess, acute yellow atrophy, phosphorus poisoning, cancer, amyloid and fatty liver, emphasizing their causes, pathological changes, symptoms, diagnosis, prognosis, and therapies. It concludes with catarrh of the bile ducts and gallstones, including their composition, formation from bile stasis and inflammation, hepatic colic, jaundice, complications, intestinal obstruction, fistulas, and aspiration or surgical treatment of abscesses.
